title: Diagram Studio deck
description: Several pages rendered as one PowerPoint, PDF or draw.io file. Each page is a diagram spec of any type (in its own file or inline), or a title or section page the engine draws. The deck sets the theme, canvas, classification and page numbers for every page.

title.description: The deck's name: file names, PDF title, and the title page unless that page sets its own.

theme.description: Theme for every page, unless a page entry sets its own.

source.description: Default source line for pages that do not give one.

pageNumbers.description: Number every page but the title page (default true).

spec.description: Path to a diagram spec, relative to this deck file.

inverted.description: Title page only: draw it full-bleed in the accent colour, like a section divider.

themeOverrides.description: Theme overrides for this page, as in a diagram spec ("color": { "accent": "#7A5CFA" } colours a divider).

tag.description: Tracker line above the title ("Exhibit 3", a section name), or the small line on a title or section page.
